title: Bean blaster calculator
description: Calculate easily the amount of windcharges needed to travel to your destination with the Iddiebean pearl Launcher
body:
# Bean Blaster Calculator

A simple client-side calculator for Bean Blasters / Pearl Launchers.

Use it to calculate how many **Wind Charges** must be placed in each dispenser to launch an Ender Pearl toward your target coordinates.

---

## Commands

### Setup the Bean Blaster

Look directly at the **magma block** of your Bean Blaster and run:

```text
/bb setup
```

You can also use:

```text
/beanblaster setup
```

The mod will save the magma block position for the current world or server.

---

### Calculate a launch

Run:

```text
/bb <x> <z>
```

Example:

```text
/bb 1250 -840
```

You can also use:

```text
/beanblaster 1250 -840
```

The mod will calculate which dispensers need Wind Charges and how many to place in each one.

---

### Help command

Run:

```text
/bb help
```

or:

```text
/beanblaster help
```

This shows the available commands and basic usage instructions in-game.

---

## Result Format

The result shows the raw amount and the Minecraft inventory version.

Example:

```text
Dispenser 1: 124 (1 Stack + 60 Items) Wind Charges
```

Inventory conversion:

```text
1 Stack = 64 items
1 Shulker Box = 27 Stacks = 1728 items
```

---

## How to Use

1. Build or find your Bean Blaster.
2. Look directly at the blaster's magma block.
3. Run:

```text
/bb setup
```

4. Choose the target coordinates where you want to launch the Ender Pearl.
5. Run:

```text
/bb <target x> <target z>
```

Example:

```text
/bb 3000 -1200
```

6. Put the shown amount of Wind Charges into the listed dispensers.
7. Use your Bean Blaster normally.

---

## Notes

* You must run setup before calculating a target.
* Setup is saved separately for each world or server.
* Setup is also separated by dimension.
* If you move or rebuild the Bean Blaster, run setup again.
* Use `/bb` instead of `/blaster` to avoid conflicts with other mods.
